items.title: AI-capex concentration & circular financing
items.detail: NVIDIA's reported ~$500B funding vehicle with Apollo/Blackstone spotlights how much of the AI build is being financed rather than cash-funded; any crack in that plumbing would hit the whole complex at once.

items.title: Oil / Strait-of-Hormuz risk
items.detail: Brent jumped to ~$84 on Hormuz/Iran headlines; a further spike would lift inflation, pressure margins and complicate the rate-cut path.

items.title: Rate-path repricing
items.detail: 2Y ~4.23% vs effective fed funds ~3.63% with cuts priced in - a hotter Aug 12 CPI could snap yields higher and pressure multiples.

items.title: Labor market cooling
items.detail: July payrolls showed job losses; supportive for cut odds now, but a fast-softening labor market is a growth/earnings risk if it continues.

items.title: Complacency near record highs
items.detail: VIX ~15.4 with indices near all-time highs leaves little cushion; positioning is stretched and pullbacks can be sharp.

items.title: Narrow breadth / rotation
items.detail: Leadership rotating toward energy/industrials; a sustained move out of mega-cap tech would drag the cap-weighted indices even as more stocks participate.
